scope: Visual review of three final native renders against the actually viewed Commons front photograph. Report only; no model edits.

decision.summary_zh: 未发现阻断建筑识别的重大可见形态错误；可作为识别形态外观候选交付，不构成完整照片复原、实测精度或全立面验收。
decision.summary_en: No blocking visible morphology defect found for a recognition-oriented exterior candidate. This is not acceptance as a complete photographic reconstruction, surveyed model or fully evidenced all-elevation replica.
conditions: Preserve source-specific dimension and floor-count conflicts in the published notes.
Keep unseen side/rear geometry and all plan dimensions labeled estimated.
Keep modern northern hotel estate block excluded from this bounded historic-building candidate.

bound_artifacts.receipt_limit: Reopen geometry/metadata facts are read from native.json produced by packaging; this reviewer independently inspected images and hashes, not the Blender reopen operation.

reference_photo.author: Livelikerw
reference_photo.coverage: Low street-level front view; perspective convergence and trees limit dimensional and entry comparison.

views.name: native-front
views.inspection: Opened directly with view_image(detail=original); visually inspected image rather than relying on file existence or renderer status.
visible: Symmetrical front with two taller projecting side pavilions and recessed middle
Three main window bays on each wing; repeated dark glazing separated by stone-colored vertical strips
Central two-stage columned tower with one front clock, gold dome and small finial
Entrance colonnade, heavy horizontal cornices and rusticated corner piers
views.assessment: Main recognition hierarchy is present. The central upper raised window pavilion/arched motif and compound cornices in the photo are noticeably simplified to a regular flat band and roof. No visible front-mesh failure or missing dominant identifying element.
views.reference_coverage: Strong photo coverage of front upper/middle facade; bottom entry/stairs partially obscured by trees in source.

views.name: native-oblique
views.inspection: Opened directly with view_image(detail=original); visually inspected image rather than relying on file existence or renderer status.
visible: Side-pavilion projection and lower central body clearly legible
Two-stage tower, gold crown and balconies remain readable at an angle
Long side face completed with regular window rhythm; parapets and roof planes close the mass
No obvious detached floating wall, gross surface hole or inverted block visible in this view
views.assessment: Geometry reads coherently as a schematic historic building candidate. Repeated side bays, depth and roof junctions cannot be checked against the one front photograph and remain estimated. Raised central window-pavilion simplification is clear from this angle.
views.reference_coverage: Photo supports front-wing projection qualitatively; long side facade, depth and roof planes not directly evidenced.

views.name: native-rear
views.inspection: Opened directly with view_image(detail=original); visually inspected image rather than relying on file existence or renderer status.
visible: Rear center recessed between two full-depth side wings
Regular rear windows, cornices and stepped roof hierarchy
No gross opening in intended wall mass or disconnected component evident at this image scale
views.assessment: Rear completion is visually coherent but not source-validated. This view cannot establish actual rear fenestration, 工-plan dimensions, adjoining fabric or northern property boundary.
views.reference_coverage: No rear-elevation photo supplied; entire detailed rear treatment is inferred.

material_simplifications.reference: The photo has a raised central roof/front window pavilion beneath the clock tower, including a central arched motif, flanking column treatment and small decorative finials.
material_simplifications.model: Central upper facade becomes a regular window band with a largely flat roof transition; this intermediate architectural composition is substantially reduced.
material_simplifications.claim_limit: Do not describe this area as a faithful photograph reconstruction.

material_simplifications.reference: Central top small windows, multiple recessed/protruding cornice layers and ornamental friezes create a richer stepped facade.
material_simplifications.model: Regularized top openings, flatter bands and simplified profiles stand in for those features.
material_simplifications.claim_limit: Source floor counts and visible rows remain unresolved; a model layer count is not independent evidence.

material_simplifications.reference: Lower clock-tower body and its supporting architecture have curved surfaces, ornate capitals, sculptural panels, detailed transitions, flanking ornaments and a more elaborate clock surround.
material_simplifications.model: Columned cylindrical stages, simple clock disc/surround and simplified rings preserve the motif; curved relief and sculptural detail are reduced.
material_simplifications.claim_limit: No claim of exact tower-profile or carved-ornament reproduction.

material_simplifications.reference: Gold dome supports a red-brown enclosed-looking lantern and needle; facade contains decorative shields, fine spandrel patterns and extensive carved/cornice detail.
material_simplifications.model: Gold dome and small finial/lantern indicate the crown; fine glazing, shields, floral relief, signage and detailed masonry profiles are simplified or omitted.

material_simplifications.reference: Front source is partly tree-obscured at ground level and does not show rear/long-side elevations.
material_simplifications.model: Entry colonnade and regularized side/rear fenestration complete a coherent model.
material_simplifications.claim_limit: Full stairs, base-opening arrangement, side/rear bay counts and roof/rear junctions are not photo-verified.

dimension_review.validation_status: Interpretive model datums, not independently measured or image-calibrated coordinates.
dimension_review.observed_qualitative_support: Photo supports taller outer pavilions, lower central body and a clock tower above both.
unresolved: The actual central-to-wing roof step is not measured.
38.16m overall with a9m tower, implemented as29.16+9, is a modeling interpretation; source text does not identify compatible endpoint datums.
The alternate36.16m historic source and40.1m renovation-project south height remain in documentary review.
Original8, described9, current10 and model9layer concepts are not forcibly reconciled.
Photograph and elevated native render cameras differ; apparent height ratios are not a dimensional acceptance test.

plan_and_scope_review.plan_width_depth: 42m by36m model footprint dimensions are estimated, not established by site1973m² or this image review.
plan_and_scope_review.historic_form: 工/H-form interpretation is supported by texts at a general level; exact plan offsets and depth are unverified.
plan_and_scope_review.northern_hotel_estate: Modern north building excluded.2026 tender north/south distinction remains an estate-scope lead, not proof of separate heritage registrations.
plan_and_scope_review.rear_status: Coherent inferred completion; no all-around photo validation claimed.

out_of_scope: Construction safety, structural design or physical restoration suitability
Exact architectural survey or photogrammetric fit
Proof that every current hotel-property component is modeled
Verification of2026 site changes against a2013 photograph
Geometry topology/numeric validation beyond image inspection and artifact hash binding
